rows.title: Picking an e-bike for commuting
views: ● v-decide-bike [comparison-table] How do these bikes stack up on what matters to me: hill climbing, maintenance, weight, theft protection, and price?
● v-motor-choices [cause-and-effect] If I pick mid-drive vs hub, what follows: how steep can I climb, how quiet is the ride, what maintenance do I face?
● v-learning-path [learning-path] What do I need to understand first: motor types, battery size, frame style, or the bikes themselves?
● v-commute-timeline [timeline] When do batteries, chains, and servicing cost kick in, and how much for each bike?
○ v-theft-methods [anatomy] What are the parts that stop a thief: the motor lock, the frame material, the lock you buy separately?
○ v-weight-tradeoff [quadrant] Where does each bike sit: heavy but strong, light but less powerful, or best of both?

○ v-weight-impact [comparison-table] How heavy is each bike with the battery, and can you carry it up one flight?

rows.title: Open-source tools for knowledge graphs in
views: ● v-comparison-table [comparison-table] Which tools have the features I need—prerequisite graphs, visual exploration, LLM help, and human curation?
● v-evidence [evidence] What evidence exists for which features are most important, and where do the tools fail?
● v-anatomy [anatomy] What are the parts of a working knowledge-graph learning tool, and how do they fit together?
● v-learning-path [learning-path] What do I need to understand first: what are prerequisites vs related concepts, and where do the different tool families sit?
○ v-outline [outline] What's covered in this research, from the evaluation rubric through tool categories to gaps?
○ v-lineage [lineage] Where did the key ideas come from—Metacademy, Lean Blueprint, roadmap.sh—and what did they lead to?
○ v-quadrant [quadrant] Which tools are production-ready, and which are experimental patterns worth learning from?

rows.title: Open-source tools for learning graphs
views: ● v-tool-comparison [comparison-table] Which tools do what? What's strong, weak, or missing in each?

○ v-visualization-substrate [learning-path] What visualization and UI libraries underpin the tools that work?
○ v-reference-closed [evidence] Closed-source products (Math Academy, Brilliant) have the graph right. What can we learn from them?
